title: Clinic appointment
scenario: I want to book my first routine clinic appointment for Friday afternoon.
opening: 初めてなのですが、予約をお願いできますか？
openingMeaning: It is my first visit. Could I book an appointment?

turns.japanese: クリニックの受付です。今日はどうされましたか？
turns.romaji: Kurinikku no uketsuke desu. Kyō wa dō saremashita ka?
turns.meaning: This is the clinic reception. How can I help today?
turns.answer: 初めてなのですが、予約をお願いできますか？
turns.answerRomaji: Hajimete na no desu ga, yoyaku o onegai dekimasu ka?
turns.answerMeaning: It is my first visit. Could I book an appointment?
turns.note: 初めて means it is your first time. You can use it to tell reception you are a new patient.

turns.japanese: ご希望の曜日と時間を教えてください。
turns.romaji: Go-kibō no yōbi to jikan o oshiete kudasai.
turns.meaning: Please tell me your preferred day and time.
turns.answer: 金曜日の午後がいいです。
turns.answerRomaji: Kin’yōbi no gogo ga ii desu.
turns.note: ご希望 is a polite way to say your preference. You are asking about availability, not confirming an appointment.

turns.japanese: 確認しますので、少々お待ちください。
turns.romaji: Kakunin shimasu node, shōshō omachi kudasai.
turns.meaning: I will check, so please wait a moment.
turns.answer: ありがとうございます。日本語はまだ勉強中なので、ゆっくり話していただけると助かります。
turns.answerRomaji: Arigatō gozaimasu. Nihongo wa mada benkyō-chū na node, yukkuri hanashite itadakeru to tasukarimasu.
turns.answerMeaning: Thank you. I am still learning Japanese, so it would help if you spoke slowly.
turns.note: 助かります means it would help. It makes your request sound polite. The appointment is still being checked.

title: Parcel redelivery
scenario: I missed a parcel delivery and want to ask about redelivery tomorrow evening.
opening: 不在票を見て電話しました。再配達をお願いできますか？
openingMeaning: I am calling about the missed-delivery notice. Could I request redelivery?

turns.japanese: 配達のお問い合わせですね。どうされましたか？
turns.romaji: Haitatsu no otoiawase desu ne. Dō saremashita ka?
turns.meaning: You are calling about a delivery. How can I help?
turns.answer: 不在票を見て電話しました。再配達をお願いできますか？
turns.answerRomaji: Fuzaihyō o mite denwa shimashita. Saihaitatsu o onegai dekimasu ka?
turns.answerMeaning: I am calling about the missed-delivery notice. Could I request redelivery?
turns.note: 不在票 is the notice left when a delivery is missed. Use a made-up tracking number if you practise this with a live agent.

turns.japanese: いつでしたら、お受け取りできますか？
turns.meaning: When would you be able to receive it?
turns.answer: 明日の夜は家にいます。
turns.answerRomaji: Ashita no yoru wa ie ni imasu.
turns.answerMeaning: I will be home tomorrow evening.
turns.note: 受け取り means receiving or collecting something. Give your availability without assuming a delivery slot is confirmed.

turns.japanese: 夜の配達ができるか確認します。
turns.romaji: Yoru no haitatsu ga dekiru ka kakunin shimasu.
turns.meaning: I will check whether an evening delivery is possible.
turns.answer: ありがとうございます。難しい場合は、受け取り方法を教えてください。
turns.answerRomaji: Arigatō gozaimasu. Muzukashii baai wa, uketori hōhō o oshiete kudasai.
turns.answerMeaning: Thank you. If that is difficult, please tell me how else I can receive it.
turns.note: 場合 means in the case that. This keeps the conversation open if your preferred time is unavailable.
